result.summary: The intersection features wide sidewalks, marked continental crosswalks, and dedicated pedestrian signals, providing a baseline level of safety. However, the presence of a large food truck parked near the corner creates a significant visual obstruction between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Food Truck
hazards.description: A large food truck is parked at the curb near the intersection, blocking sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, parked at the curb near the traffic signal pole.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears to allow for relatively high-speed vehicle turns into the crosswalk area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and commercial vehicle standing within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a dense urban commercial corridor with wide, well-maintained sidewalks and a signalized intersection. Pedestrian infrastructure includes curb ramps and dedicated signals, though the multi-lane one-way street and presence of large delivery vehicles introduce potential visibility and speed risks.

hazards.name: Sun Glare

result.summary: The image shows a standard urban street with a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps featuring tactile paving. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the crossing lacks signalization or physical traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds and ensure driver compliance.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks a traffic signal, stop sign, or pedestrian-activated warning, requiring pedestrians to step into the roadway without a guaranteed stop from vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to reduce the unprotected crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to serve as a speed table, slowing traffic and increasing pedestrian visibility.
